memory_update.text: CSW should be tracked as a mid-cap underfollowed contractor-SKU supplier for HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical, sealants and building safety products; verify organic Contractor Solutions growth and replacement/MRO mix.

SITE should be tracked as an exterior-property repair/maintenance distributor with strong branch density and recurring contractor interactions; verify maintenance plus repair/upgrade resilience versus new-construction and existing-home-sales sensitivity.

node: Housing repair-and-remodel inputs, specialty building products, replacement components, and installer-facing distribution
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe around repair-and-remodel inputs and contractor-facing fulfillment rather than consumer-facing retailers. The strongest underfollowed angle is not Home Depot/Lowe's traffic itself, but branch density, pro-contractor relationships, replacement SKUs, HVAC/plumbing/electrical consumables, exterior-property maintenance, and installer labor availability. This pass keeps mega-cap retailers as context only and surfaces four US-listed names with plausible direct or second-order exposure; all require later-layer validation on mix, organic volume, margin pass-through, and housing/new-construction leakage.
